_note: Defaults for the pool. A repository overrides them with a file of this name at its own root; the script reads that one instead and never merges the two, so an override states the whole policy. Every label name, every rating value, the ordering and the shortlist size live here, and the script writes no label this file does not name. A few operational bounds -- how many issues and labels a read may return -- are the script's own.

severity.meaning: how bad this is if nothing is done
